parameters.query:
INSERT INTO n8n_undelivered_alerts (source, workflow_name, failed_node, error_message, execution_url, delivery_error, payload)
SELECT p->>'source', p->>'workflowName', p->>'failedNode', p->>'errorMessage',
       p->>'executionUrl', p->>'deliveryError', p
FROM (SELECT convert_from(decode($1,'base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb AS p) t;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (function(){ var o; try { o = { workflowName: $('Error Trigger').first().json.workflow && $('Error Trigger').first().json.workflow.name,  failedNode: $('Error Trigger').first().json.execution && $('Error Trigger').first().json.execution.lastNodeExecuted,  errorMessage: $('Error Trigger').first().json.execution && $('Error Trigger').first().json.execution.error    && $('Error Trigger').first().json.execution.error.message,  executionUrl: $('Error Trigger').first().json.execution && $('Error Trigger').first().json.execution.url }; } catch (e) { o = {}; } o.source = 'wf3-error-alert'; try { var e1 = $json.error, d1 = $json.description; o.deliveryError = [ (e1 && e1.message) || (typeof e1 === 'string' ? e1 : null), (typeof d1 === 'string' ? d1 : null) ].filter(Boolean).join(' | ') || '알 수 없음'; } catch (e) { o.deliveryError = '알 수 없음'; } return JSON.stringify(o).base64Encode(); })() }}
